SELECT
        (SELECT min(mono_ms) FROM obd WHERE boot_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000') AS first_obd_ms,
        (SELECT max(mono_ms) FROM obd WHERE boot_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000') AS last_obd_ms,
        (SELECT min(mono_ms) FROM (
    SELECT * FROM position
    WHERE boot_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000'
      AND (coalesce(source_flags, 0) & 32 = 0
           OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM position d
                          WHERE d.boot_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND coalesce(d.source_flags, 0) & 32 = 0
                            AND d.lat != 0 AND d.lon != 0))
  ) AS pos) AS first_pos_ms,
        (SELECT min(mono_ms) FROM (
    SELECT * FROM position
    WHERE boot_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000'
      AND (coalesce(source_flags, 0) & 32 = 0
           OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM position d
                          WHERE d.boot_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND coalesce(d.source_flags, 0) & 32 = 0
                            AND d.lat != 0 AND d.lon != 0))
  ) AS pos WHERE lat != 0 AND lon != 0) AS first_fix_ms

SELECT
        CASE
          WHEN o.load_pct < 20 THEN 'light'
          WHEN o.load_pct < 50 THEN 'medium'
          ELSE 'heavy'
        END as load_zone,
        avg(o.timing_advance_deg)::decimal(4,1) as avg_timing,
        avg(b.lambda_ratio)::decimal(5,3) as avg_lambda,
        avg(b.maf_cgps)::decimal(6,1) as avg_maf,
        avg(o.speed_kph)::decimal(5,1) as avg_speed,
        avg(o.rpm)::decimal(6,0) as avg_rpm,
        count(*) as samples
      FROM boost b
      ASOF JOIN obd o ON b.vehicle_id = o.vehicle_id AND b.boot_id = o.boot_id AND b.mono_ms >= o.mono_ms
      WHERE b.maf_cgps IS NOT NULL AND b.lambda_ratio IS NOT NULL
        AND b.lambda_ratio > 0.7 AND b.lambda_ratio < 1.3
        AND o.speed_kph IS NOT NULL AND o.speed_kph > 5
        AND o.rpm IS NOT NULL AND o.rpm > 0
        AND o.timing_advance_deg IS NOT NULL
        AND o.load_pct IS NOT NULL AND b.vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000'
      GROUP BY b.vehicle_id, load_zone
      ORDER BY avg_speed

SELECT
        count(*) AS imu_samples,
        round(max(abs(accel_peak_x_mg)) / 1000.0, 2) AS peak_long_g,
        round(max(abs(accel_peak_y_mg)) / 1000.0, 2) AS peak_lat_g,
        round(max(gyro_peak_dps), 1) AS peak_yaw_dps

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT
        round(max(boost_psi), 1) AS peak_boost_psi,
        max(rpm) AS peak_rpm,
        round(avg(CASE WHEN lambda_ratio > 0 THEN lambda_ratio END), 3) AS avg_lambda,
        round(avg(stft_pct), 1) AS avg_stft,
        round(avg(ltft_pct), 1) AS avg_ltft,

SELECT
        sum(CASE WHEN alt_diff > 0 THEN alt_diff ELSE 0 END) AS gain_m,
        sum(CASE WHEN alt_diff < 0 THEN abs(alt_diff) ELSE 0 END) AS loss_m
      FROM (
        SELECT alt_m - lag(alt_m) OVER (ORDER BY mono_ms) AS alt_diff
        FROM (
    SELECT * FROM position
    WHERE boot_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000'
      AND (coalesce(source_flags, 0) & 32 = 0
           OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM position d
                          WHERE d.boot_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND coalesce(d.source_flags, 0) & 32 = 0
                            AND d.lat != 0 AND d.lon != 0))
  ) AS pos WHERE boot_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND alt_m IS NOT NULL
      )

SELECT b.boost_psi,
        coalesce(o.intake_c,
          (SELECT o2.intake_c FROM obd o2
           WHERE o2.vehicle_id = b.vehicle_id AND o2.boot_id = b.boot_id AND o2.intake_c IS NOT NULL
           ORDER BY abs(o2.mono_ms::int - b.mono_ms::int) LIMIT 1)
        ) as intake_c,
        o.rpm
      FROM boost b
      ASOF JOIN obd o ON b.vehicle_id = o.vehicle_id AND b.boot_id = o.boot_id AND b.mono_ms >= o.mono_ms
      WHERE b.boost_psi > 0 AND b.vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000'
      ORDER BY b.boost_psi

SELECT b.boot_id,
        min(b.observed_at) as first_seen,
        avg(b.ltft_pct)::decimal(4,1) as avg_ltft,
        avg(b.stft_pct)::decimal(4,1) as avg_stft,
        avg(b.lambda_ratio)::decimal(5,3) as avg_lambda,
        max(b.maf_cgps) as peak_maf_cgps,
        count(*) as samples
      FROM boost b
      WHERE b.ltft_pct IS NOT NULL AND b.vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000'
      GROUP BY b.vehicle_id, b.boot_id
      ORDER BY first_seen

SELECT b.boot_id,
        min(b.observed_at) as first_seen,
        count(*) as samples,
        avg(o.speed_kph)::decimal(5,1) as avg_speed_kph,
        max(o.speed_kph) as max_speed_kph,
        avg(b.maf_cgps)::decimal(6,1) as avg_maf,
        avg(b.lambda_ratio)::decimal(5,3) as avg_lambda,
        avg(o.rpm)::decimal(6,0) as avg_rpm,
        avg(o.timing_advance_deg)::decimal(4,1) as avg_timing,
        avg(b.ltft_pct)::decimal(4,1) as avg_ltft,
        avg(o.load_pct)::decimal(4,1) as avg_load,
        (max(b.mono_ms) - min(b.mono_ms)) / 1000.0 as duration_s
      FROM boost b
      ASOF JOIN obd o ON b.vehicle_id = o.vehicle_id AND b.boot_id = o.boot_id AND b.mono_ms >= o.mono_ms
      WHERE b.maf_cgps IS NOT NULL AND b.lambda_ratio IS NOT NULL
        AND b.lambda_ratio > 0.7 AND b.lambda_ratio < 1.3
        AND o.speed_kph IS NOT NULL AND o.speed_kph > 5
        AND o.rpm IS NOT NULL AND o.rpm > 0 AND b.vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000'
      GROUP BY b.vehicle_id, b.boot_id
      ORDER BY first_seen

SELECT b.mono_ms, b.boot_id, o.rpm, b.boost_psi,

           WHERE o2.vehicle_id = b.vehicle_id AND o2.boot_id = b.boot_id AND o2.intake_c IS NOT NULL
           ORDER BY abs(o2.mono_ms::int - b.mono_ms::int) LIMIT 1)
        ) as intake_c,
        b.lambda_ratio, b.maf_cgps, o.timing_advance_deg
      FROM boost b
      ASOF JOIN obd o ON b.vehicle_id = o.vehicle_id AND b.boot_id = o.boot_id AND b.mono_ms >= o.mono_ms
      WHERE b.boost_psi IS NOT NULL AND b.vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000'

SELECT b.mono_ms, o.rpm, b.maf_cgps, b.lambda_ratio,

      FROM boost b
      JOIN obd o ON b.vehicle_id = o.vehicle_id AND b.boot_id = o.boot_id

        FROM (
    SELECT * FROM position
    WHERE boot_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000'
      AND (coalesce(source_flags, 0) & 32 = 0
           OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM position d
                          WHERE d.boot_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND coalesce(d.source_flags, 0) & 32 = 0
                            AND d.lat != 0 AND d.lon != 0))
  ) AS pos WHERE boot_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND speed_mps IS NOT NULL
      ) WHERE lead_ms IS NOT NULL

SELECT p.lat, p.lon, p.observed_at
      FROM position p
      JOIN (
        SELECT vehicle_id, boot_id FROM v_drive_summary
        WHERE vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000'
        AND boot_id != '00000000000000000000000000000000'
        AND boot_id IN (
          SELECT boot_id FROM position WHERE vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000' GROUP BY vehicle_id, boot_id
          HAVING max(observed_at) < (SELECT min(observed_at) FROM position WHERE vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND boot_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000')
        )
        ORDER BY (SELECT max(observed_at) FROM position
          WHERE vehicle_id = v_drive_summary.vehicle_id AND boot_id = v_drive_summary.boot_id) DESC
        LIMIT 1
      ) prev ON p.vehicle_id = prev.vehicle_id AND p.boot_id = prev.boot_id
      WHERE p.lat != 0 AND p.lon != 0
      ORDER BY p.mono_ms DESC
      LIMIT 1

WITH starts AS (
      SELECT vehicle_id, boot_id, min(observed_at) AS started FROM position GROUP BY vehicle_id, boot_id
    ), dist AS (
      SELECT vehicle_id, boot_id, sum(segment_m) AS dist_m FROM (
        SELECT vehicle_id, boot_id,
          speed_mps * least(lead(mono_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY vehicle_id, boot_id ORDER BY mono_ms) - mono_ms, 10000) / 1000.0 AS segment_m
        FROM position
        WHERE speed_mps IS NOT NULL
      ) GROUP BY vehicle_id, boot_id
    )
    SELECT strftime(date_trunc('day', s.started), '%Y-%m-%d') AS bucket,
      count(*) AS trips,
      coalesce(sum(d.duration_s), 0) AS duration_s,
      coalesce(sum(dist.dist_m), 0) AS distance_m,
      coalesce(max(d.max_speed_kph), 0) AS max_speed_kph
    FROM v_drive_summary d
    JOIN starts s USING (vehicle_id, boot_id)
    LEFT JOIN dist USING (vehicle_id, boot_id)
    WHERE s.started >= '2000-01-01'::TIMESTAMP AND s.started < '2000-01-01'::TIMESTAMP
    GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
